vi trùng corona.source: A large, round, pendent chandelier, with spikes around its upper rim to hold candles or lamps, usually hung from the roof of a church; An upper or crownlike portion of certain parts of the body

vi-rút.gloss: virus infective agent; virus type of malware

vi-ta-min.source: Any of a specific group of organic compounds essential in small quantities for healthy human growth, metabolism, development, and body function. They are found in minute amounts in plant and animal foods or sometimes produced synthetically, and deficiencies of specific vitamins produce specific disorders; preceding a word or its initial letter, to imply that the referent benefits health or wellness

voi ma-mút.source: mammoth extinct elephant-like mammal; mammoth something very large

vắc-xin.source: vaccine (substance that stimulates production of antibodies)

vốt.source: A formalized choice on legally relevant measures such as employment or appointment to office or a proceeding about a legal dispute; An act or instance of participating in such a choice, e.g., by submitting a ballot
